graft.title: Depend on sylva 0.1.1 from crates.io instead of the git revision
graft.need: sylva is published: 0.1.1 on crates.io (tag v0.1.1, github.com/vaibhav-gopal/sylva public). Replace `sylva = { git = ..., rev = "7b3a7e8", default-features = false }` with `sylva = { version = "0.1.1", default-features = false }`. Since 7b3a7e8: Flat::update patches what changed instead of rebuilding (a child added or removed deep in the tree, then update: 1.5 / 3.2 us at 10k / 100k nodes; a reorder ~105 ns; a full rebuild 20 / 340 us); the forest's accessors are #[inline] (link walks ~20% faster, builds faster with warm memory); move_to skips the cycle walk for a reorder; Flat::update's bool now means 'the view changed' (patched or rebuilt); and serde for Graph and Tree works without std (the `serde` feature no longer turns std on). No API you listed changed.
graft.use_case: crates.io refuses a crate with git dependencies, so parda needs sylva from the registry to publish; and the faster Flat::update and the inlined accessors only reach parda through the version bump.

answer.text: Done (local commit, pushed when the user says): parda depends on sylva = { version = "0.1.1", default-features = false } from crates.io; Cargo.lock has no git sources left, and with autodyne 0.1.0 also from crates.io the deploy keys and the private-deps CI action are gone. Every test passes unchanged against 0.1.1, including the retained tree's and reconciliation's, so no API parda calls moved.
